articles.summary: Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) today announced the launch of Booking Partner Division, a new global B2B organization designed to help partners grow their businesses through travel, create more value for their customers, and unlock new opportunities by harnessing Booking Holdings' global reach, leading technology, expertise and continuous innovation. Building on the strengths of Booking.com Strategic Partnerships and Rocket Travel by Agoda, Booking Partner Division will work with a diverse range of businesses - from banks, financial institutions and airlines to online travel companies, travel technology platforms, affiliates, advertisers, publishers and other organizations. Its solutions will help partners promote, sell and distribute travel, build branded travel experiences, reward and engage their customers, and create new sources of growth. articles.summary: Third quarter 2026 financial results for Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) will be made available at approximately 4:00 p.m. ET on November 3 through a press release posted to the company's Investor Relations website: http://ir.bookingholdings.com . Booking Holdings intends to hold a conference call on November 3 at 4:30 p.m. ET to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results. The event will be webcasted at http://ir.bookingholdings.com and audio replays will be available on the website for seven days thereafter.
